1.w: I have loved because YHWH has heard the voice of my supplications,

2.w: Because He has inclined His ear to me, even in the day I called.

3.w: The cords of death surrounded me, and the straits of Sheol found me; distress and sorrow did I find.

4.w: And in the name of YHWH I called out: “I pray, O YHWH, deliver my soul!”

5.w: Gracious [is] YHWH, and righteous; and our God is compassionate.

6.w: YHWH preserves the simple ones; I was brought low, and to me He gave salvation.

7.w: Return my soul, to your rest, for YHWH has dealt kindly with you.

8.w: For you were rescued from death, O my soul, my eye from tears, my feet from stumbling.

9.w: I will walk before the face of YHWH in the land of the living.

10.w: I believed, therefore I said, “I afflicted am greatly.”

11.w: I said in my hastening, “Every man is a liar.”

12.w: What shall I return to YHWH; all His benefits [are] upon me?

13.w: I will take up the cup of salvation, and upon the name of YHWH I will call.

14.w: I will fulfill My vows to YHWH now in front of all His people.

15.w: Precious in the eyes of YHWH [is] the death of His holy ones.

16.w: I ask, O YHWH—surely I [am] Your servant; I [am] Your servant, son of Your maidservant—You have loosed my bonds!

17.w: To You I will sacrifice a sacrifice of thanksgiving, and in [your] name, O YHWH, I will call.

18.w: I will fulfill My vows to YHWH now in front of all His people,

19.w: in the courts of the house of YHWH, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelu YAH!
